scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:client: node init && cd client && npm run dev
scripts.dev:server: node init && cd server && npm run dev
scripts.build: node init && cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd ../server && npm install && npm run build
scripts.start: node init && cd server && npm start
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
